## About
We're a car interior shop on Linden St in Waltham. We specialize in restorations, full custom interiors, and convertible tops, and we also handle leather and vinyl repair, custom carpeting, boat covers and seats, and more.
We've built strong relationships with high end dealerships all over Boston and the surrounding areas. Our customers rate us 4.8 from 60 Google reviews, and one of them put it simply: "Great service and a great job to boot."

## Services
- Convertible tops: Convertible roof replacement. One reviewer said their Solara's new roof still looked good months later.
- Rear plastic window replacement: New rear plastic windows for convertible tops.
- Water leak repairs: Tracking down and fixing water leaks.
- Suede head liners and seats: Suede headliners and seating. One reviewer had the headliner replaced in a Porsche Cayman.
- Custom carpeting: Custom carpet for your car's interior.
- Leather and vinyl repair: Fixing torn seams and worn spots, like the driver seat stitching on one reviewer's Mini Cooper.
- Leather redying: Bringing color back to worn leather.
- Classic car restoration: Interior restoration for classic cars.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 97 Linden St, Waltham, MA 02452.

Q: Do you work on boats too?
A: Yes. We do boat covers and seats, and boat tops.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: One reviewer made an appointment, dropped the car off in the morning, and picked it up the same afternoon. Give us a call to set up a time.
